protocol: Blind evaluator (separate agent) saw ONLY blind/S01..S30.png (caption band cropped) and the book title; no narration, config or sample file. Fields: idea it would convey to a muted viewer, confidence, concerns (abridged verbatim).

descriptions.idea: The meaningful gap is between doing nothing and doing something — marker sits near 'doing something'.
descriptions.concerns: slider on chalkboard edge, labels hang below the board; ruled lines read as placeholder

descriptions.idea: Teaching what you know makes the world respond — sharing is a two-way loop.
descriptions.concerns: drawn as a straight line, not a loop; label placement inconsistent; lamppost behind circle

descriptions.idea: none — decorative/ambiguous (a coffee stain/mug matters somehow)
descriptions.concerns: mug is clean, no stain; floating lightbulb; character cropped

descriptions.idea: Something about the last week — maybe a message/post; claim unclear.

descriptions.idea: none — decorative/ambiguous
